description: This file defines a React component called SidebarNavigation, which renders a sidebar menu with navigation links, including logic for determining active links based on the current route, and styling for mobile and desktop views. It also includes utility functions for path normalization and matching.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Normalizes a URL path by removing trailing slashes, ensuring root remains '/'

methods.name: startsWithPathSegment
methods.description: Checks if the pathname starts with a given base path segment

methods.name: isNavItemActive
methods.description: Determines if a navigation item is active based on current pathname and href, with special grouping rules
